content.value_statement: Starting a Remotion project requires a reliable scaffold and video-focused layout choices. This skill creates a blank project, starts Studio, and links to focused guidance for markup, interactivity, layout, and TailwindCSS.
actual_capabilities: Scaffolds a blank Remotion project with the create-video command.
Starts a local Remotion Studio preview without opening a browser.
Links to React markup and interactivity guidance for Remotion compositions.
Provides video-first layout, safe-area, and text-sizing guidance.
Explains when TailwindCSS can be used in an existing Remotion project.
limitations: It does not design a complete video or generate finished scene content.
It requires Node.js, Git, and permission to run local package commands.
It does not install or configure TailwindCSS.
It does not render or publish a video file.

output: Keep important text inside the recommended safe area.
Use one primary message and one supporting visual per scene.
Use large, high-contrast text and reveal secondary details over time.

best_practices: Use a clear project name and confirm the current folder is suitable before scaffolding.
Build readable content with flex or grid layout containers before adding decorative layers.
Inspect representative frames at normal size before rendering the full video.
anti_patterns: Do not run scaffolding commands inside an existing project unless you intend to replace its setup.
Do not use tiny text or dense dashboard-style layouts for video scenes.
Do not use CSS transition or animate classes when frame-based Remotion animation is required.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It scaffolds a blank Remotion project and explains how to start a local Studio preview.

faq.question: Does it render a video?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the project and preview workflow, but it does not render a final file.

faq.question: Can I use it in an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. Skip scaffolding and use the linked guidance to add or improve compositions.

faq.question: Does it require TailwindCSS?
faq.answer: No. TailwindCSS is optional and must already be installed and enabled in the project.

faq.question: Why does it start Remotion Studio?
faq.answer: Studio provides a local preview and supports editing supported composition controls.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
